theme_strategy.justification: Swiss Brutalist enterprise design demands high contrast, deep blacks, and harsh lighting to emulate a 'command center' feel. Dark mode aligns perfectly with Palantir AIP's serious, operational thesis-first approach.

headings.usage: Massive thesis statements, hero sections, section titles.

mono_labels.usage: Explicit BUILT / ARCHITECTURE / MODELED proof labels, metadata, system states.

surfaces_and_textures.cards: Flat solid background (#0A0A0A), strict 1px solid border (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)), completely sharp corners (rounded-none) or max 2px. No drop shadows. Use inner glow (box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05)) for depth.
surfaces_and_textures.glassmorphism: Only used for sticky navigation. background: rgba(5,5,5,0.7), backdrop-blur-2xl, border-bottom 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1).
surfaces_and_textures.background_texture: Subtle SVG noise or film grain overlay on hero sections to kill the digital flatness (opacity 2-4%).

grid_and_layouts.general: Swiss Grid protocol. Extreme asymmetry. Grid items must snap perfectly with visible 1px borders between them (border-collapse style).
grid_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. p-8, p-12 for inner card content. py-24, py-32 for section spacing.
grid_and_layouts.taxonomy_list: For the massive Department and Industry lists, use a dense, multicolumn brutalist text grid, combined with a slow-moving marquee for inactive states.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Invert colors on hover for key CTAs (bg-white text-black). Cards should have a slight border brightness increase.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in and slight Y-translate for text blocks. System diagrams should 'build' themselves via SVG line drawing animations.
motion_and_interaction.interactive_diagrams: Use framer-motion to create stateful logic loops representing Search -> Context -> Orchestration -> Collaboration -> Execution.

architecture_components.Enterprise Search: Visualized as hybrid BM25+dense retrieval node graphs.
architecture_components.Onyx: Visualized as enterprise connectors with flowing data lines.
architecture_components.AIGIS: Stateful LangGraph orchestration shown as checkpoint nodes.
architecture_components.Colanode: CRDT shared workspace shown as a local-first node graph.
architecture_components.DeerFlow: Agent harness shown as isolated sandboxes with lead/subagent dispatch.

user_journey_routes./investor: The high-contrast gateway. Thesis-first statement. Two massive brutalist quadrants: 'INVESTOR' vs 'CUSTOMER'.
user_journey_routes./investor/role/:type: Investor destination routes (Venture Fund, Strategic Corporate, Operator, Angel). Contains waitlist/booking actions and deep architecture thesis.
user_journey_routes./investor/customer: Customer gateway. 3-step visible taxonomy selection: Role (Exec/Tech/Workflow) -> Department -> Industry. Persists state via URL query params.
user_journey_routes./investor/customer/destination: Contextualized destination weaving the 5 microservices based on the selected Role, Department, and Industry.

image_urls.usage: Use as heavily darkened (bg-black/80 overlay) background textures for the persona gateway and architecture proof sections.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter for Headings. Use Chivo font-black.
DO NOT use generic centered text alignments. Use aggressive left-alignment and asymmetric grid layouts.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating headers; use solid or blurred glass.
Implement pure HTML/Tailwind for structural marketing elements to allow maximum creative freedom, only using Shadcn for form inputs/selects.
Ensure strict URL parameter persistence for the Customer journey (e.g., ?role=executive&dept=engineering&industry=retail) rather than conditional rendering on a single page.

components_path.instruction: Use purely custom HTML/Tailwind grid structures for the main layout to enforce the Swiss Brutalist aesthetic. Use Shadcn only for deep interactive elements like Select or Dialog if needed for the taxonomy dropdowns, but heavily override their styles to be square, 1px bordered, and dark.
